mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% over three months signals an improving labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over two months signals a strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over one month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% over one month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% over three months, it signals a strong consumer-driven economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1% and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% over six months signals inflationary pressure, which leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increases by more than 2% over six months.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% over one month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% over one month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% over one quarter signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 decreases by more than 0.5% over one quarter.
